description: Find who decides in a SMALL business (a school, a market, a clinic) and how to reach them: name, role, the public origin of each fact (company site, Google Maps, Receita Federal, Instagram…), a work e-mail, the owner's mobile when it can be confirmed. Takes a name and city (and state), or a CNPJ, or a website. Charged only for what is found: 8 credits for a decision maker our search found (site, Maps, web, gazette, LinkedIn), free when the only source is the Receita's list of partners; 8 for the person's e-mail, 15 for the owner's mobile; nothing when nothing is found. A business already in our base answers at once at the same price. One business per call; a list takes one call per row. With prospectId (or sheetId and rowId) of a person of a campaign or a sheet row, the decision makers with evidence and the numbers, with whose they are, are saved to that person (the mobile goes to their phone only when it is theirs); savedTo says where. Each result names the business it is about, so parallel calls are told apart by business, not by order.

inepCode.description: The customer's own key for the row; never searched.

maxCredits.description: A cap on what this business may cost, in credits.

name.description: The business's name as the customer knows it.

phone.description: The business's own phone from the customer's list; checked first.

prospectId.description: The campaign prospect this business is looked up for: what is found with evidence is saved to them.

rowId.description: The sheet row this business is looked up for, with sheetId.

sheetId.description: The sheet of the row this business is looked up for, with rowId.

want.description: What to look for; default everything.

name: identify_business
title: Identificar decisor de pequena empresa
